How this works & references

This is a simplified desktop application launch. The OS is already running; BIOS/UEFI and POST are not repeated.

Stages separate responsibilities for explanation. In a real PC, the CPU and OS participate throughout, and loading, execution and drawing overlap. Files may already be cached; this launch illustrates a cold read from SSD.

Calculator runs locally. A network connection is not required for this example. The PSU powers the components; motherboard buses carry their data.
